editorial.author: Claude Code (AI draft) for PMH developer
reviewNotes: Narration derived only from lesson MCH68-CH-003 v0.1.0; no new content.
Thai-speaking reviewer: check pronunciation of 'สมุดหน้าสามสิบห้า', 'หมู่เลือด', 'โรคทางพันธุกรรม', 'หลอดลมตีบ', 'ยาพ่นขยายหลอดลม' and 'การวินิจฉัยโรค'.
The printed English terms 'Febrile convulsion' and 'Wheezing' are not spoken or shown; only the Thai labels are used.
Lesson note: who signs (items 1, 2, 6) is read from the printed columns ('ลงชื่อผู้ประเมิน/วันที่', 'ลงชื่อแพทย์ ... โรงพยาบาล'); the handbook does not say it in a sentence.
Lesson note: 'tell staff so they can record it' (item 8, summary 2) is derived from the printed fields; the handbook does not tell parents to report these.
Lesson note: 'bring the book every time' (summary 3) comes from PDF p2, not p37.
Not taught (as in the lesson): what febrile convulsion or wheezing is, what to do, which drugs to avoid, or what a blood group means. The 'ภาวะอื่นๆ' space is not narrated.
Not used in the video: the app-privacy line, the sort step and the family note.
